images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: shotgun style

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a one-storey gable-front worker's cottage, one window and a door on the front, a lean-to addition with a second door at the side, a woodpile; small sheds at the back -- the cheapest 1880s house

why.note: the worker's cottage: one storey, gable to the street, on a narrow lot near the factories
